title: Top AI experts badly underestimated how fast the field is moving, study finds
snippet: Leading AI experts have consistently underestimated how fast AI is advancing, according to the Forecasting Research Institute. AI reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad five years ahead of the median expert forecast, and Anthropic's annualized revenue is about five times what experts predicted. title: NHTSA investigates comma.ai’s openpilot over 5 crashes that killed 3
snippet: NHTSA has opened a formal investigation into comma.ai’s aftermarket driver assistance devices after five crashes where cars running openpilot plowed into stopped or slow-moving vehicles in their own lane. Two of those crashes killed three people. The probe covers an estimated 30,000 comma three, comma 3X, and comma four devices. It’s the biggest regulatory problem for George Hotz’s startup since NHTSA pushed it to cancel its first product back in 2016. more…

title: Thinking about buying a second car? Here’s a $1,000 alternative

title: AI Policy An Opportunity For 'Bipartisan Step Forward,' Says Miriam Vogel
snippet: Miriam Vogel, president and CEO of EqualAI, said that she heard very little partisan rhetoric when she testified on the impact of AI in front of lawmakers and described the creation of AI policy as an 'opportunity for a bipartisan step forward.' Vogel also weighed in on the AI race between the US and China, saying that China is using a 'whole of government approach' with the technology. (Source: Bloomberg)
